title: Area and Security Lighting Rental: When the Monthly Rental Is Billed
content:
The monthly rental of an **Area and Security Lighting Rental** light is billed only while the light is active, out of service or removal pending. Rental continues while the service account is idle, and is suspended for periods the service account is disconnected for nonpayment; both terms hold for every fixture.

## Light status and billing

| Status of the light rental | Rental billed? |
|---|---|
| Requested (not yet installed) | No |
| Active | Yes |
| Out of service (a confirmed light-out with a repair order open) | Yes |
| Removal pending (the member has confirmed a removal request) | Yes |
| Removed | No |
| Cancelled | No |

Whether a period's rental is billed is decided from the system record of that light rental's own status, not from what the member says, and not from the status of another light.

## Service account status and billing

| Fixture | Rental continues while the billing service account is idle | Light switched off and rental suspended while the billing service account is disconnected for nonpayment |
|---|---|---|
| LED 40W Security Light | Yes | Yes |
| LED 70W Area Light | Yes | Yes |
| LED 110W Flood Light | Yes | Yes |
| LED 150W Flood Light | Yes | Yes |
| HPS 100W Security Light | Yes | Yes |
| HPS 250W Flood Light | Yes | Yes |
| Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light | Yes | Yes |

## Questions answered for member services representatives

**A light is reported out and the report is confirmed. Does the rental stop?**
No. An out-of-service light is one of the three statuses in which rental is billed.

**A member has confirmed a request to have the light taken down, and the crew has not been out yet. Is that period billed?**
Yes. A light in removal pending is billed; billing ends once the light is removed.

**A seasonal cabin account is idled for the winter. Does the yard light's rental stop with it?**
No. Rental continues while the service account is idle.

**The service account is disconnected for nonpayment. What happens to the light?**
The light is switched off and its rental is suspended for the periods the service account is disconnected for nonpayment.

**A light has been requested but not yet installed. Is any rental billed?**
No. A requested light is not in a billed status; rental billing starts when the crew installs the fixture.
